title: Groups of multiplicative type over arbitrary schemes
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $P$ a group scheme over $S$, that is, an object of schemes over $S$ with multiplication, unit and inverse satisfying the group diagrams. Say that $P$ is of multiplicative type if there are a set $I$, commutative rings $R_i$, morphisms $f_i:\operatorname{Spec}R_i\to S$, and finitely generated additive abelian groups $M_i$ such that $\{f_i\}_{i\in I}$ is an fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site] and $P\times_S\operatorname{Spec}R_i\simeq D_{R_i}(M_i)$ as group schemes over $\operatorname{Spec}R_i$ [def-sfb-ring-diagonalizable-group] for every $i$. Finitely generated means generated as an additive group by a finite subset. This is equivalently an fppf-local form of $D_U(M)=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_U[M]$ on arbitrary covering schemes, since their affine open coverings refine the fppf covering. The groups may vary with $i$; no field, reducedness, connectedness or nonemptiness assumption on $S$ is imposed.
